words.word: we unto them after this manner

occurrences.text: Then said we unto them after this manner, What are the names of the men that make this building?
words: we unto them after this manner

occurrences.text: Then asked we those elders, and said unto them thus, Who commanded you to build this house, and to make up these walls?

And thus they returned us answer, saying, We are the servants of the God of heaven and earth, and build the house that was builded these many years ago, which a great king of Israel builded and set up.
Then Tatnai, governor on this side the river, Shethar–boznai, and their companions, according to that which Darius the king had sent, so they did speedily.
